[LCRS.6.2.3] Positionally, `as <expr>` is the trailing clause of
every `call` action — it follows all `kwarg` / `flag`
action_args and precedes only the line terminator. A kwarg appearing
after `as` is a parse error. Multi-line author convention places
`as "<corr>"` on its own line at the bottom of the call block.
